tools.name: spendguard_evaluate
tools.description: Free. Check a proposed Base USDC payment against a spending policy you supply (per-transaction limit, daily budget, human-approval threshold, allowed recipients) before money moves. Returns APPROVE, HUMAN_APPROVAL or BLOCK with findings. Advisory only: it never signs, holds keys or moves funds.

tools.name: quick_check
tools.description: A deterministic Base chain identity and official USDC contract-presence check. No request body. Not a token-risk report, transaction simulation, or payment proof. Paid tool: 0.00098 USDC per call on Base via x402 (exact scheme). An unpaid call returns the payment requirement and charges nothing.

tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Screen a Base token for sellability, taxes, privileged controls, holder concentration and market risk. Paid tool: 0.00098 USDC per call on Base via x402 (exact scheme). An unpaid call returns the payment requirement and charges nothing.

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Simulate an unsigned Base transaction and detect failed execution, dangerous approvals and destination risk signals. Paid tool: 0.00098 USDC per call on Base via x402 (exact scheme). An unpaid call returns the payment requirement and charges nothing.

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Verify an onchain Base USDC payment, its recipient, amount, status and confirmations. Paid tool: 0.00288 USDC per call on Base via x402 (exact scheme). An unpaid call returns the payment requirement and charges nothing.
